summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of tearDown being executed on skipped tests when running with --pdb. However, there are concerns about maintainability and potential regressions.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new function (tearDown_wrapper) which increases the complexity of the code. This could make the code harder to understand and maintain.
There is a risk that this change could introduce unexpected behavior in other scenarios where tearDown is conditionally skipped based on the test outcome.
